title: Review of c01's FCH uptake-cargo micelles: SIWD replicates on a fresh seed and at dt/2; W holds by equilibrium partitioning, and an emptied body refills to >=2x in ~5 time units
summary: Fresh seed 13 (dt 0.02, T=800) and seed 14 at dt/2 (dt 0.01, T=800) both form ~34 micelles from white noise that grow on the feed and divide (46 and 45 persistent splits, max generation 5 and 4, merge/split 0.03); 97.8% and 98.8% of body-frames hold the uniformly supplied solute at >= 2x the outside (aggregate 280-296x at t=800). My own chi=0 control on seed 13 gives 1.0x in every body-frame with the same body counts, so the contrast is the partitioning term. An empty-body test (seed 21, t=200: solute deleted from the 3 largest bodies) shows emptied bodies back above 2x within ~5 time units and at 70-100x by t+160, so the contents carry no memory: what daughters 'inherit' is re-equilibration, as the author's limits already state. Supported, with W marked by construction (Boltzmann partitioning into the amphiphile core).

observations.S: rerun/seed13/sheet.png t=0: white noise over the whole domain; ~34 round micelles by t=32
observations.I: rerun/seed13/sheet.png t=32-800: discrete round bodies of fixed size (~55 px at thr 0.8) that persist between fissions; occupancy rises only by number
observations.W: cargo_contrast_seed13.txt: 97.8% of 7172 body-frames >= 2x, aggregate 280x at t=800; cargo_contrast_dt2_seed14.txt: 98.8% of 7038 body-frames; control_chi0/seed13: 1.0x in every frame
observations.D: rerun/seed13/lineage.png: 46 persistent splits, max generation 5, merges 2 (ratio 0.034); rerun_dt2/seed14: 45 persistent splits, generation 4; elongate-pinch fissions visible at t=416 and t=768 on the sheets

seeds_run.result: pass (empty-body probe to t=360, not a labkit run)

controls_run.W: control_chi0/seed13 (chi=0, same seed: 1.0x everywhere, same 57 bodies at frame 100); refill_seed21.txt (emptied bodies refill to >=2x in ~5 time units)

verdicts.limitation: The containment is equilibrium partitioning c ~ exp(-chi u) of a passive solute into the amphiphile core, so any body of this field holds it: W follows from the energy term, not from a boundary the body builds (no B), and the solute does nothing for the body. Inheritance is not memory: an emptied body regains >= 2x within ~5 time units against a division interval of ~100-150. The Laplacian-only twin fails trivially (a uniform source cannot make contrast), so the beyond-diffusion credit is real but cheap. Population only grows (no deaths) and approaches packing by t=800. I did not run the 1.5x resolution or lowered-D controls; those are the author's.
